correctness.rationale: The matrix-tree leaf-deletion reduction is exact for all m>=3. A 5-state frontier forest transfer with enumerated initial and closing states proves deleted-vertex counts for all sizes using the annihilating polynomial and five consecutive initial values. Explicit Laurent coefficients and rational sqrt(3) bounds establish strict signs for all m>=5, with m=3,4 exactly enumerated. Both nonzero asymptotic covariance limits follow from dominant Chebyshev terms. Independent rational matrix-tree determinants m=3..10 and checked finite transfer state enumeration corroborate, but are not substituted for, analytic all-size proof.
